sources.content: The skerrymq-broker image packages the SkerryMQ message broker. It is built on debian:12-slim and runs as a non-root user named skerry with user ID 10001. The broker listens for client connections on port 7400 and serves a Prometheus metrics endpoint on port 9464. Mount a volume at /var/lib/skerrymq to keep queued messages across container restarts. The entrypoint is /usr/local/bin/skerrymq-broker, and it reads its settings from /etc/skerrymq/broker.toml by default.

Configure the broker through environment variables. SKERRY_CLUSTER_NAME sets the cluster name and defaults to local. SKERRY_MAX_CONNECTIONS limits concurrent client connections and defaults to 2048. Set SKERRY_TLS_CERT and SKERRY_TLS_KEY to file paths to turn on TLS; when both are unset, the broker accepts plain connections. The image includes a health check that calls the /healthz endpoint every 15 seconds and marks the container unhealthy after three failures.
